devdoc.details: Intended only for the existing fixed-supply MoteToken. Mutable, rebasing,      taxed or dishonest-balance tokens are unsupported. Balance-delta checks      reject observable non-exact transfers; they cannot authenticate a token.      Once per address is not Sybil resistance. There is no admin, mint, sweep,      allowance, reset or upgrade path. Excess/accidental funding is stranded.      Limits apply to this instance, not to independently deployed dispensers.
